name: Didgeridoo tongued drone
desc: An E didgeridoo drone driven as a bass: struct-gated tonguing rhythms retrigger the e2 fundamental with a saw gain-pump for the circular-breathing swell, overblown toots alternate <e3 b3 e3> at phrase ends, a slow filter breath opens the buzz, and a lastOf(4) doubles the tongue rhythm. Peak fills the bar with a sixteen-slot tongue groove and iter rotation. add-note transposable off E.

cut.doc: lpf sweep center Hz (opens the buzz)

code.full: stack(note("e2").add(note(${root})).s("didgeridoo").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~").attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.12).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}*.9).fast(4)).shape(.28).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.55, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)), note("<e3 e3 b3 e3>").add(note(${root})).s("didgeridoo").struct("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x").attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(${gain}*.4).hpf(400).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16))).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.12).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: stack(note("e2").add(note(${root})).s("didgeridoo").struct("x x ~ x x x ~ x x ~ x x ~ x x x").attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}*.9).fast(4)).shape(.32).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)), note("<e3 b3 e4 b3>").add(note(${root})).s("didgeridoo").struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~").attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(${gain}*.42).hpf(400).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(12)), note("e2").add(note(${root})).s("didgeridoo").struct("[~ x]*8").gain(${gain}*.3).hpf(800).shape(.3)).lastOf(2, x=>x.fast(2)).iter(4).room(.12).fast(${rate}).orbit(3).play()
